evidence.summary: Keep ENCUT consistent across energy comparisons. Choose it for the POTCAR set; a default cutoff does not establish property convergence.

MAGMOM sets initial moments and affects symmetry. Different seeds can reach different minima. Compare plausible states with the same method and cell. Zero total moment can be valid AFM; inspect local moments. A few seeds do not establish the ground state.
PBE bands and DOS use a converged SCF CHGCAR with ICHARG=11 in this runner. Keep structure and method consistent. This fixed-charge route does not apply to hybrid functionals.
Choose smearing for the electronic state. Positive ISMEAR can give unphysical occupations in insulators. Tetrahedron integration needs a suitable mesh; a line path is not a DOS mesh.
